notes.title: New Update for Tad: The Lost Explorer
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/c45d805fa701d928ced2f9ead3e00cd9645c5f60.png
 New update for Tad: The Lost Explorer 

Attention Tad fans! The faithful adventure based on the Tad: The Lost Explorer movie has a new update:

New comics!
The new update brings us a very exciting new feature.... NEW COMICS!, the comic vignettes present in the videogame have been updated with a new and amazing style, and that will surely get you to smile with its countless  references and hidden details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/44bee7a69e429bd924c49a615b16b684b83cc2eb.gif

Remember that in Tad: The Lost Explorer you will find a adventure faithful to the movie. You will have to guide Tad's steps to free his dear friends from the curse that affects them. The adventure stands out for its variety, the alternation of open 3D scenarios, which can be fully explored (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, Egypt), and 2D platform levels, in which the player's skill will be essential.
 
That is to say: scenarios to fall backwards, hours of excitement, platforms, combat, collecting, puzzles... We must also highlight the graphic section, very close to that of the film both in design and animations. 

Featured content:

 Narrative in the purest Tad Stone style.
 Freedom to explore the 3D scenarios, full of objects to collect and adventures.
 Action in the 2D levels, to show your skill at the controls.
 Countless references and surprises.
 Funny comic cinematics.
 Already available on PS4, PS5 (also in physical format) and Steam.
